They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.   Thousands  of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and  resolve.ai  to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.  Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.    What you'll do  As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering  Daniel .  You will:    Shape company and product strategy alongside our SVP of Product Engineering. It's a genuine partnership: you'll develop the vision for where Checkly goes next, decide where we play in the AI testing, monitoring, and observability landscape and where we don't, and turn that into a direction. You build the strategy with us, not execute someone else's.    Shape Checkly's point of view on reliability in an AI-native world: how teams monitor AI-generated code, agent-driven workflows, and LLM-backed features    Lead initiatives across Product Engineering, Sales and Marketing, and represent Checkly directly to customers and in developer communities.    Live in the product and the problem. Empathy for DevOps, SRE and Platform Engineering isn't a line item. It's the job.    You ship with AI where it helps and know when not to. You don't just talk about it.      What you should have    You've built software before this. You're an ex-engineer, ex-founder, or ex-solutions engineer who has written real code and shipped real things, and now you want to own the product. This one's non-negotiable: you should be able to reason about APIs, MCPs, CLIs, and how systems fit together without a translator.    You've worked in a startup, not just a big company. You're comfortable with ambiguity, small teams, and owning outcomes end to end. You don't need a big-company machine around you to be effective. About GlassFlow:  
 GlassFlow is the data infrastructure for AI agents in production. It has two products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data from every system they touch, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs what agents do once they're running. 
 We’re a Berlin startup with a Silicon Valley mentality, backed with $5.9m from Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, the ex-CTO of Aiven, and more world-class investors. 
 The founders are serial entrepreneurs with more +10y of experience in building and selling data products. 
 Tasks 
  Why is this role special  
 We are Backend Engineer at GlassFlow, you’ll be shaping the core technology, culture, and trajectory of the company. The code you write will power AI agents for billions of data events around the world. 
 You’ll be working in a fast, high-ownership environment where speed matters, curiosity is rewarded, and ambition is the norm. 
  What you’ll do  
 
 Build and scale high-performance, low-latency systems in Python. 
 Take complete ownership of projects from idea to production. 
 Ship fast, break things, learn, and ship again. 
 Help define the technical culture of GlassFlow. 
 Work directly with the founders to solve problems in a way that no one has solved before. 
 
 Requirements 
  What we’re looking for  
  You are:  
 
 Deep expertise in Python. 
 Hungry, competitive, and resilient. 
 Someone with impressive achievements that prove you’re a 10x builder. 
 A fast learner who thrives in chaos. 
 Hands-on, pragmatic, and deeply technical. 
 Actively looking for startup culture. 
 
  Previous experience that could be helpful:  
 
 Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure) 
 Experience with K8s, Docker, Docker Compose 
 Worked in fast-growing environments or early-stage startups 
 Openness to using AI tools in coding (e.g., Claude) is considered a plus 
 Ability to adapt quickly and make compromises in writing code when necessary 
 
  This role is not for you if you:  
 
 Expect long and detailed roadmaps. 
 Need a structured process or step-by-step instructions. 
 Want the “safe” path. 
 Are afraid of chaos. 
 Can’t handle pressure. 
 Want “perfect” code. 
 Are afraid of wearing multiple hats. 
 
 Benefits 
  What you’ll get  
 
 Real ownership: competitive equity (everyone at GlassFlow is an owner). 
 The chance to build something that changes how the world streams data. 
 The opportunity to build for global tech brands from day one. 
 A career trajectory that will 10x your skills and network. 
 
  Benefits:  
 
 Competitive salary with Stock Option Grant 
 Ticket for public transportation in Berlin 
 Company credit card with a monthly allowance 
 Newest tech of your choosing 
 Annual Learning budget for personal development 
 Generous WFH policy and a budget for home office setup 
 
 GlassFlow is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in the workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including those with diverse backgrounds and disabilities.
